figurative_meaning_en: Alert in listening; possessing sharp hearing ability
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গল্প শুনতে কান খাড়া করে বসল।
খবর পেয়ে সবাই কান খাড়া করে শুনছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He sat with his ears pricked up to hear the story.
Everyone is listening attentively upon hearing the news.
note: The idiom draws from the image of animals like dogs pricking up their ears when alert, common in Bengali folklore and everyday expressions.
